item.title: Version 1.28.1
item.description:
New

- Show a warning popup when a recording session's config fails to load, so settings are no longer silently lost

Improved

- Redesigned dashboard with rounded corners and Netflix-style card layout - Redesigned editor with restructured layout, native controls, and flattened UI - Strengthened release build signing with library validation and additional verification steps

Fixed

- Minor bug fixes with clip deletion, window enumeration, and window resizing
